topLevel: a campaign plays the protocol's sequence in both lanes, once per slot, one process at a time, balanced by position, and its campaign is in the format the analysis reads
a load above the limit, an undrawn presented window and an incomplete window are each rejected with their reason, kept in the raw data and redone in the same slot
an error and a process that wrote no report are rejected by the errors rule and redone; the one without a report counts against the slot's attempts and is not an execution of the format
three rejected attempts in a slot stop the campaign: the later slots do not run, the stop is recorded and the analysis produces no statistic
the other game once is redone; the second time in the same arm stops the campaign
a scenario that waited with numbers other than the protocol's stops the campaign, chosen by the problem's code, and the analysis alone would not have seen it
a protocol whose load limit is not a finite positive number is refused before anything runs, because the wait could never tell a quiet machine
the wait for the load reads it every few seconds until it is under the limit, records the wait, and a wait that runs out lets the attempt run to be judged by the rule
a campaign interrupted after the k-th attempt, or twice, resumes from the first open slot and ends as a campaign that was never interrupted
a campaign is not resumed if the protocol, the script, the binary, the package or the instrument has another hash, or the options are not the same; nothing runs and the state stays as it was
the self-check is the gate: if it fails nothing runs, the stop is recorded, and a resume repeats it until it passes
an engine or a renderer other than the one the self-check ran on stops the campaign
the self-check runs in the lane the launcher runs in: a window for a launcher that opens one, headless for one that does not, and a check in the other lane is not the campaign's renderer
the unlimited lane whose vsync does not read back DISABLED is N/A and is not run further, and says so
a rehearsal redoes nothing, is marked as one and says in its deviations that it is not a result
the Release launcher refuses with the reason, before anything is run or written
the command line: --build debug and --slots are for a rehearsal, the numbers are checked, and a campaign needs its build and its directory
a file is written whole or not at all
the plan is the protocol's sequence in each lane in turn, limited to the slots asked for
the next step is the first slot without an accepted attempt: its redo before the next slot, no redo in a rehearsal
the analysis' stops stop it, a slot whose attempts are used up counts the ones that wrote no report, and what the analysis cannot see stops it too
the unlimited lane is N/A from the first attempt whose vsync did not read back DISABLED, and its slots do not run
the executions of a campaign are the attempts that have one, numbered 1, 2, ... in each slot
a resume checks the hashes of the protocol, the script, the binary and the package, what was registered, and the options
the wait for the load stops at the first reading under the limit, gives up when the time is spent, and the limit itself is quiet enough
the lock is taken with the pid, a token and the directory of the campaign, refuses a live holder, takes over a dead one's and is released only by its holder
a process is alive if a signal can be asked of it, and the default lock is in the system's temporary directory
two campaigns that take over one stale lock at the same time: exactly one holds it afterwards, whatever the interleaving, and no mutex is left
a second campaign's whole takeover lands between the first's reading of the stale lock and its mutex: the first refuses and the live lock is not removed
a lock released by the campaign that took it while another takeover was waiting removes no live lock, and the waiting campaign takes the free lock
a mutex left by an interrupted takeover, or held by one that is going on, refuses the next campaign, naming it, and changes nothing
a campaign does not start while another is alive on the machine, whatever its directory, and starts when the lock is free
a lock left by a campaign that was killed is taken over, and the lock is released when a campaign fails
the self-check runs the probe headless or in a window as it is asked, and a check that passed records the lane and the hash of the instrument's file
a window that no display presented, an oracle that rejects, a probe that fails or writes nothing, and a log with a hidden error do not pass the check
